title: Section
description: A Section is a named structural region within a Page (e.g. header, main, sidebar). It groups Components and gives the page layout a semantic, graph-addressable structure.

name.description: The PascalCase name of the section.

description.description: A human-readable explanation of what this section contains.

role.description: The semantic role this section plays within the page.

components.description: The Components rendered within this section, in order.

examples.name: Main
examples.description: Primary content region of the loan detail page.
